features: Universal Lightning Compatibility – Designed for Apple devices with a Lightning port, including iPhone 14, iPhone 13, iPhone 12, iPhone 11, iPads, and other Lightning-enabled devices. Ensures a secure and reliable connection for everyday use.

Type-C OTG Adapter – Easily connect USB Type-C accessories such as flash drives, keyboards, card readers, and compatible peripherals to your Lightning-enabled iPhone or iPad for convenient data access.

Fast 480 Mbps Data Sync – Supports data transfer speeds of up to 480 Mbps, allowing you to quickly transfer photos, videos, documents, and other files between compatible devices. Data transfer only; charging is not supported.

Pocket-Sized Portable Design – Lightweight and compact construction fits easily into your pocket, wallet, laptop bag, or travel pouch, making it an ideal companion for work, travel, and everyday carry.

Premium & Durable Construction – Built with high-quality materials for enhanced durability and long-lasting performance. The sleek black finish complements your Apple devices while resisting daily wear and tear.

Easy Plug & Play Operation – No drivers, apps, or additional software required. Simply plug the adapter into your compatible Lightning device and connect your USB Type-C accessory for instant data transfer.

Ideal for Daily Data Management – Perfect for transferring files, photos, videos, and documents at home, in the office, or while traveling. A practical accessory for users who need a compact and dependable Lightning to USB Type-C OTG adapter.
